faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Why do I need to request access?
faq.a1: Ixiera is currently in Early Access. We manually verify each account to ensure the best experience and manage server capacity. We will notify you via email once your account is approved.
faq.a2: Yes, during the Early Access phase, all features are completely free to use.
faq.q3: Does it auto-post without my permission?
faq.a3: No. By default, Ixiera will draft replies for your review. You can enable full-auto mode later if you trust the AI persona.
